description: Mobilfunk-Monitoring - BNetzA - Januar 2022 is a dataset listed in GDI-DE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Bundesamt für Kartographie und Geodäsie. This dataset contains data from the Federal Network Agency (BNetzA) as of January 2022 on mobile telephony coverage in the Free State of Saxony by mobile telephony technology. BNetzA collects the supply data from the operators of public mobile networks. Coverage: DE. The portal shows the English title as "Mobile monitoring - BNetzA - January 2022" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Mobilfunk, DE-SN, Dynamic Spectrum Sharing, Breitband, weiße Flecken, Unterversorgung. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-gdi-de.
